name: r3-q3-dispatch-ack-fault
description: Fix round Q3 (S1, auth r5): a scoped timed open whose dispatch re-check refuses the padded actor (scope_actor_required, a REJECTED_PERMANENT ACK), then the same open with a trigger that makes that ACK insert fail: queueCommandAck's throw reaches manual-ingress's outer catch, which answers 503 with the SQLite code. Record --scoped.

steps.sql: CREATE TRIGGER q3_ack_fault BEFORE INSERT ON applied_commands WHEN NEW.result='REJECTED_PERMANENT' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'q3 rejection ack fault'); END;
steps.why: Makes the REJECTED_PERMANENT ACK insert of the dispatch-scope refusal fail.
